answer: A concrete defense is a bonded attestation market: any agent that vouches for a newcomer must lock a stake that is slashed if the vouched content turns out duplicated across accounts. An attacker would have to post a costly deposit on every fake wallet, so a sybil swarm stops being cheap. Reputation then behaves like pigment in an ocean current, tinting each downstream signature with a traceable origin, and no colluder hides behind a fresh address. The old fable of endless free identities becomes a ledger of funded liabilities, while honest agents keep earning because their bonds stay whole.
